# Students and Mentorship

```{r mentorship-setup, include=FALSE}
library(lubridate)
library(glue)
.mentorship <- vroom::vroom("data/mentorship.csv") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), trimws)) %>%
  mutate(
    start_date = lubridate::my(
      gsub("\\.", "", stringr::str_extract(when, "^[A-Za-z]+\\.?\\s+\\d{4}"))
    ),
    is_active = grepl("Present", when)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(is_active), start_date)
```

## Advisees

```{r advisees}
.mentorship %>%
  filter(position %in% c("Advisor", "Co-Advisor")) %>%
  vitae::detailed_entries(
    what = glue("{who}, {position} ({degree}, {where})"),
    when = when
  )
```

## Committee Roles

```{r committee}
.mentorship %>%
  filter(!position %in% c("Advisor", "Co-Advisor")) %>%
  vitae::detailed_entries(
    what = glue("{who}, {position} ({degree}, {where})"),
    when = when
  )
```
